items.title: CMU robotics facilities draw IROS 2026 attendees
items.summary_en: CMU News reports that hundreds of academics and industry leaders toured CMU robotics sites during the IROS 2026 conference in Pittsburgh. The tours covered the Robotics Innovation Center, Mill 19 and the National Robotics Engineering Center.
items.notes: OUTSIDE the 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-21 window; included only as low-priority context. Exact publication day not confirmed (October 2026 archive; tours reportedly on Oct 1). Based on a search snippet only; page not fetched. Press-release style, not research.

coverage_note: No Robotics Institute or CMU News items dated 2026-11-11 to 2026-11-21 were found. Direct fetch of www.ri.cmu.edu failed (host not resolvable; it likely needs to be added to the session's allowed network domains), so only one web search was run and its snippets used. The search's most recent items were from October 2026 and earlier. These included the Pathways Fellowship call, Team Chiron reaching the DARPA Triage Challenge final phase, a BFM-Zero humanoid skill-switching story, and NSF support for robotic hand design. None of these had verifiable dates, so they are not itemized. No linked preprints were checked. This is not proof that nothing was published; a re-run with ri.cmu.edu access is recommended.
